name: A Treat for a Friend
summary: A goblin asks you to bring a treat to Jezap Jinglesprocket in Bolder'ok. Snufflesnout's happiness matters most to him.

sections.title: A Goblin's Request
sections.body: A goblin in Bolder'ok sends you with a bundle of goods for Jezap Jinglesprocket. He says Snufflesnout will be pleased to receive it. He also asks you to tell Jezap to talk less.

faq.answer: The goblin says the treat is for Snufflesnout.

faq.q: Who should I deliver the goods to?
faq.answer: The bundle of goods is for Jezap Jinglesprocket in Bolder'ok.

faq.q: What message should I pass along?
faq.answer: The goblin asks you to tell Jezap to stop talking so much.
The goblin calls Snufflesnout the one whose happiness matters most, then identifies Snufflesnout as Chub'chob.

attribution: In-game quest text: A Treat for a Friend
